label: Figure 3.4: The demand for e-readers and e-books
alt: Two panels. E-readers: a fall in price from p to p1 is a movement along demand curve D. E-books: the demand curve shifts right from D to D1.
caption: E-reader panel: a fall in the price of e-readers from p to p1 is a movement along the demand curve, raising quantity demanded from q to q1. E-book panel: e-books are a complement, and more e-readers in use means more e-books wanted, so demand shifts right from D to D1; at the same price p quantity demanded rises from q to q1.
